vendors.name: Anchore Enterprise
vendors.offering: SBOM storage, CycloneDX/SPDX import-export, policy and compliance reporting
vendors.pricing: AWS Marketplace 12-month contract dimensions, no single list price: Enterprise Helm deployment $50,000; Enterprise Cloud Image (single host) $34,500; Essential Customer Success Plan add-on $15,000; custom pricing available

vendors.name: Interlynk
vendors.offering: SBOM automation platform: storage, monitoring, VEX and policy enforcement
vendors.pricing: free Community tier; AWS Marketplace 12-month SaaS contracts by active developers: $18,000 (10), $36,000 (25), $60,000 (50), $100,000 (100)

vendors.name: sbomify
vendors.offering: Open-source SBOM hub for publishing and sharing SBOMs with customers
vendors.pricing: Community $0; Business $159/month billed annually ($199 billed monthly); Enterprise tier listed without public price

vendors.name: Manifest

vendors.name: Sonatype SBOM Manager
vendors.offering: SBOM management and vulnerability tracking for produced and consumed software

vendors.name: Cybeats SBOM Studio
vendors.offering: SBOM management, sharing and vulnerability monitoring

vendors.pricing: quote; tiers by SBOM import volume

vendors.name: Docker Scout

paid_market_gaps.gap: Artifact attestations for private repos require GitHub Enterprise Cloud; smaller teams can't tie SBOMs to releases cheaply
Management platforms mostly quote-only; few transparent-priced options for small manufacturers facing CRA SBOM duties
Inspector exports only CycloneDX 1.4; bundled exports lag current CycloneDX spec and VEX
SBOM-based vulnerability management yields noisy results; VEX workflow to suppress false positives remains immature

wtp_evidence: Public list prices: Anchore Enterprise $34,500-$50,000/year plus $15,000 support plan; Interlynk $18k-$100k/year by active developers; sbomify Business $159/month billed annually.
bundling_note: GitHub and Docker already bundle SBOM attestations at build, but cross-vendor SBOM/VEX lifecycle management and regulator-facing workflows are not given away by platforms.
summary: Modest opening: SBOM+VEX lifecycle management for SMB manufacturers facing EU CRA (Dec 2027) and FDA 524B, with transparent pricing. Crowded with funded specialists (Anchore, Manifest, Interlynk); attestation alone is bundled by GitHub/Docker.
